hints.title: Time Participant Association
hints.text: Link each competitor with their recorded completion timestamp.

hints.title: Ascending Chronological Sort
hints.text: Order entries from lowest to highest elapsed time.

hints.title: Extracted Participant List
hints.text: Collect and return the participant identifiers in sorted chronological sequence.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def restoreOrder(self, times: List[int], participants: List[str]) -> List[str]:
        # Pair times and participants, then sort by completion time ascending
        pairs = sorted(zip(times, participants), key=lambda x: x[0])
        return [p for _, p in pairs]
```

complexity.notes: Sorts participant indices according to finishing times.
